title: Audit Finding
description: A single audit finding produced by an AI audit agent or auditor. Supports both the base SAAF finding format and the extended access-review-agent format.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the finding

category.description: Exception category produced by the access review agent

affected_user_ref.description: Anonymized user placeholder (USER-NNN). Never a real identifier.

control_refs.description: List of control/standard references applicable to this finding

control_objective.description: The control objective, standard, or regulatory requirement this finding relates to (legacy field)

observation.description: Factual description of what was found

impact.description: Potential consequences if the finding is not addressed

owner.description: Name or function responsible for remediation

ai_assisted.description: Whether this finding was identified or drafted with AI assistance

detected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the finding was detected

source.description: The tool or agent that produced this finding (e.g. access_review_agent)

evidence_references.description: List of evidence item references supporting this finding
